items.title: Purple Innovation Inc (PRPL) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Cash Flow Turns Positive as ...
items.summary: Purple Innovation Inc (PRPL) posted a 19% revenue decline and cut its EBITDA outlook, but three straight quarters of positive operating cash flow and a major product launch offer a path to recovery.

items.title: Amazon Challenges Google Shopping With Direct Product Feeds
items.summary: The tool now has a free self-service portal that allows external online stores to feed their product catalogs directly into Amazon searches and Alexa for Shopping.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Nov. 5: Amazon Shares Slide as Technology Selloff Erases Early Gains
items.summary: On Nov. 5, 2026, Amazon shares reversed an early rally as rising yields and tech selling took over the session.

items.title: Quantinuum’s Revenue Triples. What It Really Wants Is Quantum for the Masses.
items.summary: Quantinuum’s revenue more than tripled to $9.1 million, ahead of the $8.1 million analysts had expected.

items.title: Oracle Stock Slides as AI Trade Swoons
items.summary: Oracle stock fell 7.6% Thursday, pulled down by broader fears around the AI trade post-election and continuing a slide that has seen them lose nearly 20% over the past month.

items.title: Baird Cut Its Qualcomm Target to $320. It Still Sees 104% Upside
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBaird cut its Qualcomm price target to $320 from $400 after the fiscal fourth-quarter report and kept its Outperform rating. Qualcomm’s phone chip sales are shrinking as Apple moves to its own modems, while its data center chips start shipping to Amazon and a second hyperscaler.

items.title: Amazon’s Ad Auctions in the Spotlight
items.summary: Amazon’s biggest headache today isn’t so much its stock price as it is a Federal Trade Commission press release calling out new details from its lawsuit alleging the online retailer secretly messed with auction prices for advertisers in order to boost its revenue.

items.title: Affirm delivers quarterly results and guidance beat, raises full-year GMV outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- Affirm on Wednesday delivered a quarterly top- and bottom-line beat and provided current quarter revenue guidance that beat expectations. The company also raised its fiscal full-year gross merchandise volume (GMV) outlook.
